_about: Text changes the web build makes to its COPY of the shell; the source is never edited. The shell's own web wording lives in its string tables as keys ending in @web (shell/strings/<lang>.js), switched on here for every language at once. Each 'find' must occur exactly once in its file, or the build stops, so a shell change that affects the web wording is caught. {keys} becomes the game's keysHelp from its web.json. A game's own changes go in its web.json. config: the web page's privacy policy, and no coin packs (no Google Play to sell them through).
